title: Test first emitter memory model

target.original_word_evidence: The G64-041 report records that all 110 local ROM words matched the pinned assembly annotations. This report contains no raw opcodes or ROM data; the ROM comparison was not repeated for G64-042.

host_model.semantics: Mock memory behavior and expected command words; not original-MIPS emulation, instruction scheduling proof, or matching-C evidence.
coverage: 1,000 seeded synthetic cases check all 22 output words, cursor advancement, and unchanged buffer guards.
Zero X/Y and zero owner flags check valid zero-input behavior across the same 22 output words.
An aligned u32 memory[32] with cursor memory+8 checks an aliased owner byte and surrounding guard regions.
The alias pointer is (u8 *)memory + 26*sizeof(u32) - 0x5D, so owner[0x5D] aliases memory[26], the B400 command w0 slot.
The alias case seeds that byte to one, asserts one before the call, then checks that B400 w0 clears it before B400 w1 is observed as zero.
Stack-backed cursor and owner pointers are restored before the test helpers return.
host_model.invalid_preconditions: Null cursor and null owner pointers are invalid preconditions: the modeled original path directly dereferences them and has no null guard. No null behavior is asserted.
assertions: All 22 modeled command words are asserted in order.
The output cursor advances by 22 words from memory+8 to memory+30 in the two boundary cases.
First and last command words and all prefix/suffix sentinels are checked.

order_mutant.description: A temporary mutant reads owner[0x5D] before emitting the B400 w0 word.
order_mutant.result: Rejected at the alias assertion memory[27] == 0 because the mutant writes the seeded flag bit into B400 w1.
order_mutant.temporary_artifact: Mutant source and executable remained under /tmp and are not tracked.

decision.reason: The host fixture checks modeled write order and valid memory boundaries, but does not prove original MIPS identity. Preserve the production GLOBAL_ASM ownership.

focused_asan_ubsan.result: 1000 synthetic cases plus zero and owner-alias cases passed.
